about: Four agents plan a one-day school trip to a science museum for 30 students: a planner, a researcher, a writer and a critic, one after the other. All run on Cloudflare, free tier.
how: Each agent gets the task and the text of the agent before it. The last agent, the critic, gives the final text.
learns: A longer chain adds a step for every kind of work, but every step also costs time: the four agents took over a minute.
watch: What each agent adds, and how long each step takes on this provider.
